rows.label: qst650311_msg0001
rows.name: Is something wrong?

rows.label: qst650311_msg0002
rows.name:
The Hresvelgr Mercenaries get all
kinds of requests, but...

rows.label: qst650311_msg0003
rows.name:
We don't have many people free, so we
can't keep up.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0004
rows.name: All right. Leave it to us.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0005
rows.name: Ask us anything.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0006
rows.name: Then I'll take you up on that...

rows.label: qst650311_msg0007
rows.name:
Please defeat the Nomad Rhino around
Faaren Waters.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0008
rows.name:
Then please take care of the Noblis
Grog too.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0009
rows.name: Please defeat the Nilva Upa too.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0010
rows.name: They're piling up...

rows.label: qst650311_msg0011
rows.name:
While I am at it, could you help
collect Rainbow Water Bugs too?

rows.label: qst650311_msg0012
rows.name:
Then please get some Water Ladybirds
too.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0013
rows.name: You're not holding back...

rows.label: qst650311_msg0014
rows.name: Is that everything?

rows.label: qst650311_msg0015
rows.name:
If I can ask one more thing, please
defeat the River Bunnits around the
Cleansing Spring too.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0016
rows.name: ×××の○○○の収集もやって

rows.label: qst650311_msg0017
rows.name:
Please also defeat the Musaido Ardun
around the Sternum Arch.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0018
rows.name: That's all.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0019
rows.name: Got it. That's easy enough.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0020
rows.name: Leave it to us.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0021
rows.name: Ugh...

rows.label: qst650311_msg0022
rows.name:
Don't you think we're biting off a
bit more than we can chew here?

rows.label: qst650311_msg0023
rows.name: It's fine, it's fine.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0024
rows.name:
We've got strong Drivers and
dependable companions, after all.

rows.label: qst650311_msg0025
rows.name: Sigh... Showing off again...
